19049: function rotasticQueueLaunchTickerNotifications(notifications) {
19050:   const now = Date.now();
19051:   (notifications || []).forEach(function(n) {
19052:     if (!n || n.read) return;
19053:     const created = new Date(n.createdAt || 0).getTime();
19054:     if (!created || created > now || (now - created) > 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return;
19055:     const key = rotasticNotificationUniqueKey(n);
19056:     if (rotasticLaunchNotificationKeys.has(key)) return;
19057:     rotasticLaunchNotificationKeys.add(key);
19058:     rotasticLaunchNotificationQueue.push(Object.assign({}, n, {_launchKey:key}));
19059:   });
19060:   rotasticLaunchNotificationQueue.sort(function(a,b) {
19061:     return new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
19062:   });
19063: }

19375: async function rotasticPushBackendFetch(options) {
19376:   if (!ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT) throw new Error('Push endpoint is not configured');
19377:   let token = '';
19378:   try {
19379:     if (rotasticBackendClient && rotasticBackendClient.auth) {
19380:       const sessionResult = await rotasticBackendClient.auth.getSession();
19381:       token = sessionResult && sessionResult.data && sessionResult.data.session
19382:         ? String(sessionResult.data.session.access_token || '')
19383:         : '';
19384:     }
19385:   } catch (_) {}
19386:   if (!token) throw new Error('Authenticated ROTASTIC session required for push');
19387: 
19388:   const opts = Object.assign({}, options || {});
19389:   opts.headers = Object.assign({}, opts.headers || {}, {
19390:     'Authorization':'Bearer ' + token,
19391:     'apikey':ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
19392:   });
19393:   return fetch(ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT, opts);
19394: }

19396: async function sendAnnouncementPushToAll(messageText) {
19397:   if (!messageText) return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
19398: 
19399:   // Real multi-device push requires a shared backend/Web Push service.
19400:   // If an endpoint is configured by deployment, send the announcement there.
19401:   if (ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT) {
19402:     try {
19403:       const response = await rotasticPushBackendFetch({
19404:         method: 'POST',
19405:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
19406:         body: JSON.stringify({
19407:           type: 'announcement',
19408:           title: 'ROTASTIC Announcement',
19409:           body: messageText,
19410:           centre: 'Abu Nakhla Health Centre',
19411:           createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
19412:         })
19413:       });
19414: 
19415:       if (!response.ok) {
19416:         throw new Error('Push broadcast request failed');
19417:       }
19418: 
19419:       return { ok: true, mode: 'backend' };
19420:     } catch (error) {
19421:       console.warn('ROTASTIC push broadcast failed:', error);
19422:       return { ok: false, reason: 'backend-failed' };
19423:     }
19424:   }
19425: 
19426:   // Local-device notification fallback only.
19427:   try {
19428:     if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
19429:       new Notification('ROTASTIC Announcement', {
19430:         body: messageText,
19431:         icon: undefined
19432:       });
19433:       return { ok: true, mode: 'local-only' };
19434:     }
19435:   } catch (error) {
19436:     console.warn('Local announcement notification failed:', error);
19437:   }
19438: 
19439:   return { ok: false, reason: 'no-push-backend' };
19440: }

20343: function getTickerDisplayDuration(text, minimumMs) {
20344:   const chars = String(text || '').trim().length;
20345: 
20346:   // Allow comfortable reading time. Short items stay brisk; longer items remain
20347:   // visible for proportionally longer instead of disappearing mid-read.
20348:   const readingMs = chars * 85;
20349:   return Math.max(minimumMs || 6500, Math.min(18000, readingMs));
20350: }

20499: function formatPrayerTime12h(value) {
20500:   if (!value) return '';
20501:   const clean = String(value).split(' ')[0].trim();
20502:   const parts = clean.split(':');
20503:   if (parts.length < 2) return clean;
20504: 
20505:   let hour = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
20506:   const minute = parts[1];
20507:   const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
20508: 
20509:   hour = hour % 12;
20510:   if (hour === 0) hour = 12;
20511: 
20512:   return `${hour}:${minute} ${suffix}`;
20513: }
20514: 
20515: function prayerTimeToMinutes(value) {
20516:   if (!value) return null;
20517:   const raw = String(value).trim();
20518:   const ampm = /\b(AM|PM)\b/i.exec(raw);
20519:   const parts = raw.replace(/\s*(AM|PM).*/i, '').split(':');
20520:   if (parts.length < 2) return null;
20521:   let h = parseInt(parts[0],10);
20522:   const min = parseInt(parts[1],10);
20523:   if (isNaN(h) || isNaN(min)) return null;
20524:   if (ampm) {
20525:     const isPM = ampm[1].toUpperCase() === 'PM';
20526:     h = h % 12;
20527:     if (isPM) h += 12;
20528:   }
20529:   return h * 60 + min;
20530: }

20532: function getActiveUserShiftWindowToday() {
20533:   const today = getTodayScheduleDay();
20534:   if (!today || !activeUserDocName) return null;
20535: 
20536:   const briefing = chooseSingleDailyBriefing(today, activeUserDocName);
20537:   if (!briefing || !briefing.title) return null;
20538: 
20539:   const title = briefing.title;
20540:   if (title.indexOf('09:00–16:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('AM Twilight') !== -1) {
20541:     return {start:9*60, end:16*60, label:'AM Twilight 9–4'};
20542:   }
20543:   if (title.indexOf('14:00–20:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('PM Twilight') !== -1) {
20544:     return {start:14*60, end:20*60, label:'PM Twilight 2–8'};
20545:   }
20546:   if (title.indexOf('AM shift') !== -1) {
20547:     return {start:7*60, end:14*60, label:'AM shift'};
20548:   }
20549:   if (title.indexOf('PM shift') !== -1) {
20550:     return {start:16*60, end:22*60, label:'PM shift'};
20551:   }
20552:   return null;
20553: }

20555: async function fetchAbuNakhlaPrayerTimes() {
20556:   const now = getQatarClock();
20557: 
20558:   if (abuNakhlaPrayerTimes && abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate === now.isoDate) {
20559:     return abuNakhlaPrayerTimes;
20560:   }
20561: 
20562:   try {
20563:     // Abu Nakhla Health Centre area, Qatar.
20564:     const latitude = ABU_NAKHLA_LAT;
20565:     const longitude = ABU_NAKHLA_LNG;
20566:     const url =
20567:       `https://api.aladhan.com/v1/timings/${now.apiDate}` +
20568:       `?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&method=8`;
20569: 
20570:     const response = await fetch(url);
20571:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Prayer time request failed');
20572: 
20573:     const payload = await response.json();
20574:     const timings = payload && payload.data && payload.data.timings;
20575:     if (!timings) throw new Error('Prayer times unavailable');
20576: 
20577:     abuNakhlaPrayerTimes = {
20578:       Fajr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Fajr),
20579:       Dhuhr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Dhuhr),
20580:       Asr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Asr),
20581:       Maghrib: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Maghrib),
20582:       Isha: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Isha)
20583:     };
20584:     abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate = now.isoDate;
20585:     return abuNakhlaPrayerTimes;
20586:   } catch (error) {
20587:     return null;
20588:   }
20589: }

20669: function shuffleArray(items) {
20670:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items.slice() : [];
20671:   for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
20672:     let j;
20673:     try {
20674:       const random = new Uint32Array(1);
20675:       crypto.getRandomValues(random);
20676:       j = random[0] % (i + 1);
20677:     } catch (e) {
20678:       j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
20679:     }
20680:     const temp = arr[i];
20681:     arr[i] = arr[j];
20682:     arr[j] = temp;
20683:   }
20684:   return arr;
20685: }

21153: function getPrayerMomentAlert(prayerTimes) {
21154:   if (!prayerTimes) return null;
21155: 
21156:   const shift = getCurrentUserShiftWindow();
21157:   if (!shift) return null;
21158: 
21159:   const now = getQatarClock().minutes;
21160:   const names = ['Fajr','Dhuhr','Asr','Maghrib','Isha'];
21161: 
21162:   for (const name of names) {
21163:     const value = prayerTimes[name];
21164:     const minute = prayerTimeToMinutes(value);
21165:     if (!value || minute === null) continue;
21166: 
21167:     // Only prayers that genuinely occur during this doctor's shift.
21168:     if (minute < shift.startMinutes || minute > shift.endMinutes) continue;
21169: 
21170:     const delta = minute - now;
21171:     if (delta < -10 || delta > 10) continue;
21172: 
21173:     let message = '';
21174:     if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1) {
21175:       message = `It is time for ${name} prayer.`;
21176:     } else if (delta > 1) {
21177:       message = `${name} prayer is in ${delta} minutes • ${value}.`;
21178:     } else {
21179:       message = `${name} prayer began ${Math.abs(delta)} minutes ago • ${value}.`;
21180:     }
21181: 
21182:     return {
21183:       name:name,
21184:       time:value,
21185:       delta:delta,
21186:       message:message
21187:     };
21188:   }
21189: 
21190:   return null;
21191: }

21193: function getRelevantPrayerMessages(prayerTimes) {
21194:   if (!prayerTimes) return [];
21195: 
21196:   const now = getQatarClock().minutes;
21197:   const names = ['Fajr','Dhuhr','Asr','Maghrib','Isha'];
21198:   const shift = getCurrentUserShiftWindow();
21199: 
21200:   const prayers = names
21201:     .map(function(name) {
21202:       return {
21203:         name:name,
21204:         value:prayerTimes[name],
21205:         minute:prayerTimeToMinutes(prayerTimes[name])
21206:       };
21207:     })
21208:     .filter(function(x) {
21209:       return x.value && x.minute !== null;
21210:     })
21211:     .sort(function(a,b) { return a.minute - b.minute; });
21212: 
21213:   // If the doctor has a clinical shift today, only announce prayers that
21214:   // are still upcoming and occur while that doctor is actually on duty.
21215:   if (shift) {
21216:     const shiftRelevant = prayers.filter(function(x) {
21217:       return x.minute >= now &&
21218:              x.minute >= shift.startMinutes &&
21219:              x.minute <= shift.endMinutes;
21220:     });
21221: 
21222:     if (shiftRelevant.length) {
21223:       return shiftRelevant.map(function(x) {
21224:         return `🕌 ${x.name} prayer during your shift is at ${x.value}.`;
21225:       });
21226:     }
21227: 
21228:     // Once every prayer within the shift has passed, do not announce an
21229:     // unrelated prayer outside that doctor's working period.
21230:     if (now >= shift.startMinutes && now <= shift.endMinutes) {
21231:       return [];
21232:     }
21233:   }
21234: 
21235:   // Outside a scheduled shift, keep the general "next prayer" behaviour.
21236:   const upcoming = prayers.filter(function(x) {
21237:     return x.minute >= now;
21238:   });
21239: 
21240:   if (upcoming.length) {
21241:     return [`🕌 ${upcoming[0].name} prayer today is at ${upcoming[0].value}.`];
21242:   }
21243: 
21244:   // After Isha, retain the earlier behaviour of pointing to tomorrow's Fajr.
21245:   if (prayerTimes.Fajr) {
21246:     return [`🕌 The next prayer is Fajr tomorrow at ${prayerTimes.Fajr}.`];
21247:   }
21248: 
21249:   return [];
21250: }

21830: function makeShortMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName) {
21831:   const raw = String(title || '')
21832:     .replace(/\s+-\s+Google News\s*$/i, '')
21833:     .replace(/\s+-\s+(NICE|Medscape|JAMA|NEJM|The Lancet|BMJ|Sidra Medicine|Hamad Medical Corporation)\s*$/i, '')
21834:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
21835:     .trim();
21836:   const direct = fitNormalTickerCopy(raw, 15, 108);
21837:   if (direct) return direct;
21838:   const t = raw.toLowerCase();
21839:   const rules = [
21840:     [/meningococcal/, 'Meningococcal disease: recognition, treatment and prevention'],
21841:     [/microbiome/, 'Microbiome research may reshape future therapies'],
21842:     [/(glp-?1|tirzepatide)/, 'New GLP-1 evidence relevant to primary care'],
21843:     [/diabet.*renal|renal.*diabet/, 'Diabetes care: protect cardiovascular and renal health'],
21844:     [/obes|weight loss|weight management/, 'New evidence in obesity treatment and weight management'],
21845:     [/hypertens|blood pressure/, 'New evidence in hypertension diagnosis and treatment'],
21846:     [/asthma/, 'New evidence in asthma diagnosis and treatment'],
21847:     [/(copd|chronic obstructive)/, 'New evidence in COPD management'],
21848:     [/sepsis/, 'Updated sepsis recognition and management guidance'],
21849:     [/vaccin|immunis|immuniz/, 'New evidence in vaccination practice'],
21850:     [/antibiotic|antimicrobial/, 'New antimicrobial prescribing evidence'],
21851:     [/mental health|depress|anxiety/, 'New evidence in primary-care mental health'],
21852:     [/screening/, 'New evidence in screening practice'],
21853:     [/thyroid/, 'New evidence in thyroid diagnosis and management'],
21854:     [/family medicine|primary care|general practice/, 'New evidence relevant to family medicine'],
21855:     [/clinical trial|randomi[sz]ed trial/, 'Important new clinical trial relevant to primary care'],
21856:     [/guideline|guidance/, 'Important new clinical guidance for primary care']
21857:   ];
21858:   for (const rule of rules) if (rule[0].test(t)) return fitNormalTickerCopy(rule[1], 15, 108);
21859:   return '';
21860: }

21862: function chooseLatestMedicalHeadline() {
21863:   rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = '';
21864: 
21865:   let regional = rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines;
21866: 
21867:   if (!regional.length) {
21868:     regional =
21869:       Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || [];
21870:   }
21871: 
21872:   // Prefer Qatar / Arab-region clinical news strongly.
21873:   if (regional.length) {
21874:     const top = regional.slice(0, Math.min(regional.length, 20));
21875:     const totalWeight = top.reduce(function(sum, item) {
21876:       return sum + Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
21877:     }, 0);
21878: 
21879:     let pick = Math.random() * totalWeight;
21880:     let chosen = top[0];
21881: 
21882:     for (const item of top) {
21883:       pick -= Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
21884:       if (pick <= 0) {
21885:         chosen = item;
21886:         break;
21887:       }
21888:     }
21889: 
21890:     rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
21891:       name:chosen.sourceName,
21892:       domain:chosen.domain
21893:     };
21894:     // Avoid repeating a recently shown medical headline/summary.
21895:     const candidates = top.filter(function(item) {
21896:       const summary = makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
21897:       return summary && !rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.includes(summary);
21898:     });
21899:     if (candidates.length) {
21900:       chosen = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
21901:       rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:chosen.sourceName, domain:chosen.domain};
21902:     }
21903:     rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = String(chosen.link || '');
21904: 
21905:     const summary = makeShortMedicalHeadline(chosen.title, chosen.sourceName);
21906:     if (summary) {
21907:       rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.push(summary);
21908:       if (rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.length > 6) rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.shift();
21909:     }
21910:     return summary;
21911:   }
21912: 
21913:   const pool = rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines.length
21914:     ? rotasticLatestMedicalHeadlines
21915:     : (
21916:         rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates.length
21917:           ? rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates
21918:           : []
21919:       );
21920: 
21921:   if (pool.length) {
21922:     const headline = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(pool.length, 6))];
21923: 
21924:     rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
21925:       name:'Google News medical feed',
21926:       domain:'news.google.com'
21927:     };
21928: 
21929:     return '🩺 ' + makeShortMedicalHeadline(headline, 'Medical News');
21930:   }
21931: 
21932:   // Never leave the MEDICAL slot empty. This is explicitly a source landing
21933:   // page, not a fabricated article headline.
21934:   const fallback =
21935:     ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_SOURCE_FALLBACKS[
21936:       Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_SOURCE_FALLBACKS.length)
21937:     ];
21938: 
21939:   rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
21940:     name:fallback.sourceName,
21941:     domain:fallback.domain
21942:   };
21943:   rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = fallback.link;
21944: 
21945:   return makeShortMedicalHeadline(fallback.title, fallback.sourceName);
21946: }

22112: function rotasticRefillShuffleBag(length, lastIndex) {
22113:   const bag = Array.from({length:length}, function(_, i){ return i; });
22114:   for (let i = bag.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
22115:     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
22116:     const tmp = bag[i]; bag[i] = bag[j]; bag[j] = tmp;
22117:   }
22118:   if (bag.length > 1 && bag[0] === lastIndex) {
22119:     const tmp = bag[0]; bag[0] = bag[1]; bag[1] = tmp;
22120:   }
22121:   return bag;
22122: }

22228: function chooseWeightedMedicalStat() {
22229:   const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
22230:     const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
22231:     let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
22232:     if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
22233:     else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
22234:     else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
22235:     return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
22236:   });
22237: 
22238:   const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
22239:     return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
22240:   });
22241:   if (!sourcePool.length) return '';
22242: 
22243:   // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
22244:   if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
22245:     const weighted = [];
22246:     sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
22247:       for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
22248:     });
22249:     for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
22250:       const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
22251:       const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
22252:     }
22253:     // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
22254:     const ordered=[];
22255:     weighted.forEach(function(idx){
22256:       if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
22257:     });
22258:     // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
22259:     const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
22260:     rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
22261:   }
22262: 
22263:   const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
22264:   return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
22265: }

22267: function getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta) {
22268:   if (!meta || meta.kind !== 'sick' || !meta.date || !meta.shift) {
22269:     return {active:false, reason:'not-sick'};
22270:   }
22271: 
22272:   const shift = String(meta.shift || '').toUpperCase();
22273: 
22274:   let startMinutes = null;
22275: 
22276:   if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT AM') !== -1) {
22277:     startMinutes = 9 * 60;          // 09:00
22278:   } else if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT PM') !== -1) {
22279:     startMinutes = 14 * 60;         // 14:00
22280:   } else if (shift.indexOf('AM SHIFT') !== -1 || shift === 'AM') {
22281:     startMinutes = 7 * 60;          // 07:00
22282:   } else if (shift.indexOf('PM SHIFT') !== -1 || shift === 'PM') {
22283:     startMinutes = 16 * 60;         // 16:00
22284:   } else if (shift.indexOf('FULL DAY') !== -1) {
22285:     startMinutes = 7 * 60;          // treat full-day alert as starting with AM shift
22286:   }
22287: 
22288:   if (startMinutes === null) {
===== 22297-22552 =====
22297:   }
22298: 
22299:   const elapsed = now.minutes - startMinutes;
22300: 
22301:   // Sick alert priority is active only from shift start until 59:59 after start.
22302:   return {
22303:     active: elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < 60,
22304:     elapsedMinutes: elapsed,
22305:     startMinutes:startMinutes
22306:   };
22307: }

22766: function rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message) {
22767:   if (rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) return;
22768:   const text = String(message || '').trim();
22769:   if (!text) return;

22773:     rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
22774:     return;
22775:   }

22778:     type:type || 'general',
22779:     message:text,
22780:     medicalLink:type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : ''
22781:   });

22784:   rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;

22805: function navigateRotasticTickerHistory(direction) {
22806:   if (!rotasticTickerHistory.length) return;
22807: 
22808:   if (direction < 0) {
22809:     if (rotasticTickerHistoryCursor <= 0) return;
22810:     showRotasticTickerHistory(rotasticTickerHistoryCursor - 1);
22811:     return;
22812:   }
22813: 
22814:   if (rotasticTickerHistoryCursor < rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1) {
22815:     showRotasticTickerHistory(rotasticTickerHistoryCursor + 1);
22816:   } else {
22817:     renderNextTickerSlot();

22821: function initializeTickerSwipeHistory() {
22822:   const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
22823:   if (!ticker || ticker.dataset.swipeHistoryBound === '1') return;
22824:   ticker.dataset.swipeHistoryBound = '1';
22825: 
22826:   ticker.addEventListener('touchstart', function(event) {
22827:     const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0];
22828:     if (!touch) return;
22829:     rotasticTickerTouchStartX = touch.clientX;
22830:     rotasticTickerTouchStartY = touch.clientY;
22831:   }, {passive:true});
22832: 
22833:   ticker.addEventListener('touchend', function(event) {
22834:     const touch = event.changedTouches && event.changedTouches[0];
22835:     if (!touch) return;
22836: 
22837:     const dx = touch.clientX - rotasticTickerTouchStartX;
22838:     const dy = touch.clientY - rotasticTickerTouchStartY;
22839: 
22840:     // Horizontal swipe only; vertical scrolling/pull-to-refresh remains untouched.
22841:     if (Math.abs(dx) < 48 || Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy) * 1.35) return;
22842: 
22843:     if (dx > 0) navigateRotasticTickerHistory(-1); // swipe right = previous
22844:     else navigateRotasticTickerHistory(1);        // swipe left = next/resume
22845:   }, {passive:true});
22846: }

23580: function renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(data, totalDurationMs, recurring, persistent) {

23582:   // On true app opening, show a compact personal rota briefing with a very
23583:   // prominent room/clinic assignment plus Code Blue, emergency and shift lead.

23593:       data.message = freshVibe;

23624:   greeting.className = 'ticker-opening-greeting';
23625:   greeting.textContent = data.greeting || 'Good day, Doctor';

23628:   detail.className = 'ticker-opening-detail';
23629:

23631:   cursor.className = 'ticker-typewriter-cursor';

23640: 
23641:   let index = 0;
23642:   const chars = Array.from(detailText);
23643:   const total = Math.max(4200, Number(totalDurationMs || 5000));
23644:   const typingBudget = Math.min(1150, Math.max(650, chars.length * 14));
23645:   const delay = chars.length
23646:     ? Math.max(14, Math.min(38, typingBudget / chars.length))
23647:     : 20;
23648: 
23649:   const finishGreeting = function() {
23650:     if (persistent) return;
23651: 
23652:     const elapsedTyping = chars.length * delay;
23653:     const hold = Math.max(900, total - elapsedTyping);
23654: 
23655:     if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
23656:     headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
23657:       ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
23658:       renderNextTickerSlot();

23660:   };
23661: 
23662:   const typeNext = function() {
23663:     if (index >= chars.length) {
23664:       if (cursor.parentNode) cursor.remove();
23665:       finishGreeting();
23666:       return;
23667:     }
23668: 
23669:     detail.textContent += chars[index++];
23670:     detail.appendChild(cursor);
23671:     headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(typeNext, delay);
23672:   };
23673: 
23674:   if (chars.length) {
23675:     typeNext();
23676:   } else {
23677:     finishGreeting();
23678:   }
23679: 
23680:   if (!persistent) {
23681:     scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
23682:   }
23683: }

25795:     if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;
25796:     if (!profileSetupIsComplete()) return;

25798:

25800:     const noTimer = !headlineTickerTimer;
25801: 
25802:     if (stale || noTimer) {
25803:       try {
25804:         if (headlineTickerTimer) {

25810:         });

25813:       }
